turn.context: From the landing page: Proceed with next step. Playbook §3, the five-part overview.

text: Here is the answer. It has five parts, and they only work together.
None of them needs a new hospital system on day one.
chat.pointer: Pick any piece of the picture to see what it does and what it relies on.
chat.invite: Choose a part to start with. You can take them in any order.
chat.note: Five parts, one picture. Take one away and there is a hole.
prompts: Which part saves the most time?
Do we need to hire anyone?

moves.prompt: Do we need to hire anyone?

blocks.title: Five parts, one picture
blocks.deck: Each part answers a cause Diagnosis found. Each one also leans on the others.

idea.title: Use the evening, give it an owner
idea.line: Start the going-home work on the evening round, with one person in charge of every discharge.
causes: Nobody in charge of the whole discharge
idea.how: Parts 1 and 2 use the evening hours. Parts 3 and 4 give the discharge one owner. Part 5 shows us if it works.

pieces.name: Automations
pieces.line: Papers and the bill start on the evening round, by themselves.
pieces.needs_first: Your IT team lets Tojo read your records
changes: The summary is drafted from notes already in your files
The bill stays up to date through the stay
The insurance request can go the evening before

pieces.name: Changes on the wards
pieces.line: The going-home work moves to the night before the patient leaves.
pieces.needs_first: A two-week trial on one ward
changes: Nurses start the checklist after the evening round
Admission work stops waiting behind discharges
pieces.ask: Tell me about the changes on the wards

pieces.name: People who must agree
pieces.line: Who has to say yes, and what each group gives up.
pieces.answers: Nobody in charge of the whole discharge
pieces.needs_first: A yes from your Head of Operations
changes: Typists check drafts instead of typing them
Doctors sign an early summary, as they do for cash patients
Billing finishes the bill by 9 PM
pieces.ask: Tell me about the people who must agree

pieces.name: Team and roles
pieces.line: One person owns every discharge, with helpers for the two busy times.
pieces.answers: Nobody in charge of the whole discharge
pieces.needs_first: The trial shows your two busy times
changes: A Discharge Manager owns each discharge from start to end
One helper for the morning, one for the evening round
Each helper sized to your busiest hours
pieces.ask: Tell me about the team and roles

pieces.name: Measures we will watch
pieces.line: The numbers that tell us, week by week, if it is working.
pieces.needs_first: Real times from one normal week
changes: Minutes a bed stays empty after the patient leaves
